name: Riverside Park Campground (Evart)
evidence: City of Evart official per-site map (West Campground Map): RV sites 4-8 on the loop's east arc at the Muskegon River bank (sold as River Sites); satellite 43.8972,-85.2568 (z18): those pads on open grass ~20-30 m from the ~60 m-wide river; old pin sat 150 m NW on the playfield

name: Riverside RV Park (Vassar)
evidence: satellite 43.3735,-83.5778 (z18): 10 gravel pull-ins in the city park, Cass River ~55-65 m SE behind a continuous treeline; city page itself says the river is .04 mi from the park -> not waterfront

name: Rifle River Recreation Area - Ranch Rustic Campground
evidence: MI DNR Rifle River campground map: sites 150/152/153 at the loop's south end on the Rifle River; midnrreservations per-site attrs tag 152-153 Adjacent To: River; satellite 44.3910,-84.0363 (z18): those grass pads ~20-30 m from the ~15 m stream across grass and scattered shrubs (creekside by width)

name: Rifle River Recreation Area - Spruce Rustic Campground
evidence: MI DNR campground map: river runs west/south of the loop, no site on it; midnrreservations tags no Spruce site Adjacent To: River (Ranch's are); satellite 44.3863,-84.0338 (z18): clearings in conifer woods with trees between them and the stream -> not waterfront

name: Ross Lake State Forest Campground
evidence: MI DNR Ross Lake SFC page: forested campground with no direct lake views, water reached by steep narrow footpaths (bench); satellite 46.4849,-86.2661 (z17-18): site clearings in continuous canopy 30-70 m back from the shore -> not waterfront

name: Round Lake State Forest Campground
evidence: Esri current imagery canopy-illegible; Wayback 2018 z18: small sandy clearings ~20 m off the SE shore of ~200 m Round Lake behind a tree fringe, no legible pads; no per-site map; DNR says along the shoreline with views; on-water not earned, lakeview kept; loop not located under canopy, so the pin is left as is (GNIS/OSM node 45.1350,-84.4528 is 120 m S, unconfirmed)

name: Sand Lake Recreation Area Campground
evidence: rec.gov 233715 per-site coords plotted on satellite 44.1659,-85.9365 (z18): nearest sites 17/18 ~60 m from the water, behind forest and the day-use swim beach; no site carries a water/shoreline attribute -> not waterfront

name: Schecks Place State Forest Campground
evidence: satellite 44.6527,-85.4558 (z17-18): loop roads and site clearings 25-70 m north of the ~12 m Boardman River behind continuous riparian woods; midnrreservations tags none of sites 1-30 Adjacent To: River (the DNR tag used at Rifle River); no counting source -> not waterfront
